rows.value: UK Biobank + CARDIoGRAMplusC4D CAD (van der Harst 2018)
rows.quote: GWAS summary statistics for CAD were obtained from a GWAS meta-analysis in CARDIoGRAMplusC4D (including UK Biobank), which involved 122,733 cases and 424,528 controls, primarily of European ancestry [16].
rows.reference_quote: van der Harst P, Verweij N. Identification of 64 novel genetic loci provides an expanded view on the genetic architecture of coronary artery disease. Circ Res. 2018;122(3):433–43.
rows.coder_note: Rule E: the sentence attributes the CAD GWAS to reference 16 (van der Harst 2018, DOI 10.1161/circresaha.117.312086), a source with two dictionary rows; 'meta-analysis in CARDIoGRAMplusC4D (including UK Biobank)' matches the combined row and not the UK Biobank-only row, and 122,733 cases / 424,528 controls are the sums of that row's components (34,541 + 88,192; 261,984 + 162,544). No conflict.
Rule I1: 'FinnGen Biobank' with counts only (21,012 CAD cases and 197,780 controls); no release number, citation, year or accession in any passage.

rows.quote: GWAS summary statistics for fasting insulin were obtained from the Meta-Analysis of Glucose and Insulin-related Traits Consortium (MAGIC) [14].
rows.dataset_named_in_source: Meta-Analysis of Glucose and Insulin-related Traits Consortium (MAGIC)
rows.coder_note: The sentence names the MAGIC fasting insulin GWAS with its citation [14] (Chen 2021, DOI 10.1038/s41588-021-00852-9); the dictionary has no row of the pqtl side for a MAGIC dataset (its MAGIC row is of the outcome side), so no pqtl row can be coded.

rows.quote: We used GWAS data from the discovery cohort which were restricted to participants of European ancestry (n = 34,557).
rows.reference_quote: Sun BB, Chiou J, Traylor M, Benner C, Hsu Y-H, Richardson TG, et al. Plasma proteomic associations with genetics and health in the UK Biobank. Nature. 2023;622(7982):329–38.
rows.coder_note: Rules E and F: passage p002 is one description of the UKB-PPP data, attributed to reference 23 (Sun 2023, DOI 10.1038/s41586-023-06592-6) in its first and third sentences; the pinned sentence of that description gives the subcohort (discovery cohort), the ancestry (European) and the exact N (34,557), which only the discovery row has. The 54,219 in the same passage describes the whole project, not the data used.

rows.quote: Specifically, we obtained genetic associations with proteins from deCODE genetics, conducted in 35,559 Icelanders [28].
rows.reference_quote: Ferkingstad E, Sulem P, Atlason BA, Sveinbjornsson G, Magnusson MI, Styrmisdottir EL, et al. Large-scale integration of the plasma proteome with genetics and disease. Nat Genet. 2021;53(12):1712–21.
rows.coder_note: The sentence attributes the protein associations to deCODE genetics [28] (Ferkingstad 2021, DOI 10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w, one dictionary row) with its exact N, 35,559 Icelanders; no conflict.
